rules: When the outcome is Review Requested: a deck version is exported and self-checked. Include absolute paths to the deck folder, its README.md, CLAIMS.md, deck_storyboard.md and the research brief.
When the outcome is Deck Fix: fix the findings and export a new version. Include the absolute path to slide-review-report.md.
When the outcome is Research Gap: get research for the claims the review names, or take them off the slides. Include the absolute path to slide-review-report.md.
When the outcome is Review Passed: report the reviewed deck to whoever asked for it. Include absolute paths to slide-review-report.md, the reviewed PDF and the deck folder.
